figures.interpretation: Exact half-Hamiltonian oscillator and hyperbolic flows, and the labelled projection of the entire length-four nilpotent orbit.
Exact allowed spectral regions with M=2,delta=1,center5i,radius9/2 and counterclockwise orientation; no particular eigenvalues are asserted.
